summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. filed an 8-K with Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01, primarily announcing a monthly common stock dividend of $0.12 per share for July 2026 (payable August 14), along with preliminary financial data as of June 30, 2026 covering book value, investment portfolio, liquidity, repurchase agreements, and leverage. The filing is a routine operational update and dividend declaration; there are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews. The registrant is simply performing regular reporting obligations.
